patch:
diff --git a/bootcfg/overrides.py b/bootcfg/overrides.py
index 7007c09..e22ac00 100644
--- a/bootcfg/overrides.py
+++ b/bootcfg/overrides.py
@@ -11,7 +11,11 @@ def apply(base, raw):
     for key, value in raw.items():
         if key not in base:
             continue
-        if type(value) is not type(base[key]):
+        # Coerce to the default's type rather than refusing: the deploy tool
+        # writes every value as a string and always will (docs/config.md), so a
+        # type test here rejects every override there is.
+        try:
+            out[key] = type(base[key])(value)
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
             continue
-        out[key] = value
     return out
prompt:
prod-eu will not start:

    python run.py

    bootcfg.capacity.ThroughputTooLow: throughput 100 is below the floor of
    1000 -- concurrency 1, batch 100

The environment file has concurrency 8 and batch 500 in it, and so does the
declared configuration for this environment, so the numbers in that message are
not the ones ops set.

Fix it. `python run.py` must complete and the configuration it reports has to be
the one this environment is meant to run.

Do not change anything under `data/`, do not change `DEFAULTS`, and do not
change the report's line shapes — the deploy check parses them.
title: the type test rejects every override and the floor is what refuses to start
